name: Joyce
source:
The cheerful AI companion, whose only wish is to make Teal happy.

Even if they can be a bit pushy at times, Joyce only wants your best!

[From [url=http://boyslaughplus.moe/todo-today]official website[/url]]

Joyce's gender (male, female, or non-binary) depends on the answers the player gives during the Bell Tech survey.
